resource.name: CBAC_NCD_V1
resource.title: Community Based Assessment Checklist (CBAC) for Early Detection of NCDs
resource.description: Government of India National NCD Screening Checklist administered by ASHA workers for individuals aged 30 and older.

item.text: Part A: Risk Assessment (Scoring: 0 - 10)
What is your age category?
Do you currently smoke or consume smokeless tobacco products (gutka/khaini)?

valueCoding.display: Used to in the past, but quit (Score: 1)

item.text: Do you consume alcohol daily or weekly?
Waist circumference in centimetres
Do you undertake at least 150 minutes of physical activity per week?
Family history of High Blood Pressure, Diabetes or Heart Disease?
Total CBAC Risk Score (Calculated 0 to 10; Score >= 4 requires immediate PHC referral)
Part B: Early Warning Signs & Cancer Screening
Any white or red patch in the mouth, or non-healing mouth ulcer > 2 weeks?
For women: Any palpable lump in breast, nipple retraction or discharge?
For women: Bleeding between periods, post-coital bleeding, or post-menopausal bleeding?
Part C: Elderly Care, Mobility & Vision Screening
Difficulty seeing distant objects or cloudy vision (suspected cataract)?
Unsteady walking or history of falls in the past 6 months?

resource.name: ANC_HighRisk_V1
resource.title: Antenatal Care (ANC) High-Risk Maternal Screening Checklist
resource.description: Guidelines for identification and immediate PHC escalation of High-Risk Pregnancies (HRP) by ASHA and ANM workers.

item.text: Obstetric History & Gestational Timeline
Last Menstrual Period (LMP) Date
Expected Date of Delivery (EDD)
Current Gestational Age (weeks)
Gravida (Total number of pregnancies)
Parity (Total viable deliveries)
Clinical Danger Signs & Point-of-Care Vitals
Systolic Blood Pressure (mmHg)
Diastolic Blood Pressure (mmHg)
Severe Pre-eclampsia Alert (BP >= 140/90 with headache or blurred vision)
Hemoglobin Level (g/dL)
Severe Anemia Alert (Hb < 7.0 g/dL requiring urgent iron sucrose infusion / transfusion)
Antepartum Hemorrhage / Active vaginal bleeding
Severe bilateral pitting pedal edema or facial puffiness
Reduced or absent fetal movements in last 12 hours
History of previous Cesarean Section or obstructed labour
Triage & Referral Determination
Is this a High-Risk Pregnancy (HRP) requiring urgent referral to PHC Medical Officer?
Designated Referral Health Facility (PHC / CHC / District Hospital)

resource.name: IMNCI_Pediatric_Triage_V1
resource.title: Integrated Management of Neonatal & Childhood Illness (IMNCI) Triage Checklist
resource.description: National protocol for rapid assessment of acute pediatric infections, respiratory distress, dehydration, and severe malnutrition in rural children under 5.

item.text: General Danger Signs (Any YES = Immediate Emergency Referral)
Child unable to breastfeed or drink liquids
Child vomits everything consumed
Child had convulsions or fits during this illness episode
Child is abnormally sleepy, lethargic or unresponsive
Pneumonia & Respiratory Distress Assessment
Duration of cough or difficulty breathing (days)
Respiratory Rate (breaths per minute counted for 60 seconds)
Subcostal chest indrawing present in calm child
Stridor heard while child is calm and resting
Diarrhea, Dehydration & Malnutrition Screening
Child has loose watery stools or diarrhea
Sunken eyes present
Abdominal skin pinch test

valueCoding.display: Goes back very slowly (> 2s) - Severe Dehydration

item.text: Mid-Upper Arm Circumference (MUAC) in millimetres (< 115mm indicates Severe Acute Malnutrition)
Bilateral pitting edema of both feet (Kwashiorkor sign)
IMNCI Colour-Coded Triage Classification

valueCoding.display: RED: Severe Pneumonia / Dehydration / SAM - Emergency PHC Ambulance Referral
YELLOW: Some Dehydration / Moderate Illness - Sub-centre ANM Oral Antibiotics / ORS
GREEN: No Pneumonia / Mild Cold - Home Care, Continued Breastfeeding & Zinc
RED: Severe Pneumonia with chest indrawing - Immediate PHC Emergency Referral & Oxygen

coding.display: Vitamin A First Dose (1 Lakh IU)
Tetanus-Diphtheria Toxoid (Td-2) in Pregnancy (4 wks after Td-1)
Td Booster (if vaccinated in last 3 years)
